text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Milord Trainer, please watch your step. 
The floor is exceptionally slippery from 
the wax.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Now... take my hand. Allow me to escort 
you safely to the other side.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it. Protecting my lord is 
a knight's duty. If I have been of 
service, it is the greatest honor—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Words of praise, well... Truly, it's—
